Attorney Danny Sheehan joins Danny Jones for a talk on aliens, false stories, and a secret state within the state. The episode title bills Sheehan as Harvard's UFO lawyer. He has worked big public cases for decades and now works on UFO law.

Sheehan tells what he says he saw in classified files and what he thinks the state still hides. He argues that lies planted in the press have kept the public in the dark. Jones asks what proof can be shown in court. Listeners get a lawyer's take on the UFO file. The library holds it as an archive record, without a side taken.
podcast-joerogan-NSFaaq3vhfY:
Filmmaker Dan Farah joins the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 2416 to discuss his UFO disclosure documentary. Farah gathered on-camera statements from officials and pilots for a film meant to push the subject into the open. Rogan's show is a natural stop for such a project.

Farah tells Rogan who agreed to speak, what they said, and what he left on the cutting floor. Rogan asks how a filmmaker checks claims that come from inside secret programs. The episode works as a behind-the-scenes record of disclosure as media strategy, and of the moment when UFO talk moved from podcasts to Congress and back.
